title: Animals of Africa
text:
Lions live in Africa. They live in groups called prides. A lion can run very fast, and it sleeps for many hours each day.

Elephants are also large animals in Africa. They eat grass, leaves and fruit. Elephants live in family groups, and the oldest female leads the group.

questions.text: Why might a lion sleep for many hours each day?
options: Because it saves energy for hunting
Because it cannot see at night
Because it does not like Africa
Because it is afraid of elephants

questions.text: Who is most likely to lead an elephant group?

vocabulary.definition: having lived for the longest time

paragraph_translations: Aslanlar Afrika'da yaşar. Prides adı verilen gruplar halinde yaşarlar. Bir aslan çok hızlı koşabilir ve her gün birkaç saat uyur.
Filler de Afrika'daki büyük hayvanlardır. Çimen, yaprak ve meyve yerler. Filler aile gruplarında yaşar ve en yaşlı dişi grubu yönetir.
